defects.summary: C5 initialization validation repeatedly treated separately rendered PNG identity as animation-pose identity, creating false failures after otherwise successful T09 validation.
defects.visible_symptom: Run 35205184308 passed scope/contracts, 17 impacted suites with 997 checks, save/device matrices and C6, then failed before visual fan-out because repeated t=0 final-skeleton probes differed by 1.037-1.471 degrees against the strict 1-degree start limit.
defects.triage: The shipping T06 chop/mine/dismantle clips were not disproven. The failure occurred in the T09 evidence harness and is classified as tooling/test failure rather than a production-motion defect.
defects.affected_production_object: T09 C5 evidence harness only; shipping Character 1 mesh, rig and T06 clips remain unchanged.
defects.probable_root_cause: The pose-space replacement exposed a second harness defect: settle_pose restarted the animation on every settle frame and warm_pose restarted it once more after warming, discarding the SkeletonModifier3D convergence they were intended to establish. capture_cycle then restarted t=0 again immediately before frame 0000.
defects.causal_tooling_change: Start each sampled pose once, advance eight convergence frames without restarting, preserve the settled t=0 pose for frame 0000, keep the strict 5 mm / 1 degree limits, and make the source contract reject any return of the post-settle restart pattern.
defects.expected_visible_result: Rendered C5 evidence remains visually unchanged; equivalent t=0 poses no longer fail because unrelated pixels differ, while a real post-warm-up skeleton discontinuity still fails closed.

defects.summary: C5 settle frames advanced the live AnimationPlayer clock after an explicit seek, so the recorded start pose was a later real-time animation sample.
defects.visible_symptom: All scope/contracts, 17 suites / 997 checks, save/device matrices and C6 passed, then the C5 preflight measured start drift of 0.079358-0.095225 m and 23.328-28.325 degrees; chop first-step drift reached 0.153894 m / 56.060 degrees.
defects.root_cause: set_pose sought the requested sample but left AnimationPlayer running. Eight render-settle frames advanced real time by about 0.13 seconds, invalidating the explicit t=0 proof.
defects.causal_tooling_change: Freeze AnimationPlayer.speed_scale at 0.0 before play/seek/advance(0.0), retain settle frames for SkeletonModifier3D convergence, and require the frozen-clock token in the fail-closed T09 source validator. C5 limits remain unchanged.

defects.summary: The T09 workflow called the C0 diagnostic reusable workflow without granting its required actions: read permission, causing an exact-source startup_failure before any T09 job was created.
defects.visible_symptom: GitHub resolved havenline-c0-root-cause.yml but completed the T09 run as startup_failure with zero jobs.
defects.root_cause: Reusable workflows cannot elevate GITHUB_TOKEN permissions above the caller. The T09 caller granted contents: read only, while the C0 diagnostic requires actions: read to retrieve failed-run evidence.
defects.causal_tooling_change: Grant actions: read at the T09 workflow top level and make the T09 source validator require the C0 job, reusable workflow reference, and actions: read permission together.
